evidence.note: Hope Utilities announced on Aug 14, 2025 that its subsidiary NEO will build, own and run a new central Ohio gas pipeline for an AEP fuel cell project at a data center, in service by October 2026. Length, diameter and counties not stated.
Ohio regulators approved AEP Ohio onsite fuel cell units at Amazon Web Services and Cologix data centers, the fuel cell load the pipeline serves.

seed_ledger.name: Kinetik residue connections to power plants (Pecos Power, Basin Ranch)
seed_ledger.reason: NO_DC_TIE: Kinetik signed zero-capital interconnects from its Delaware Link residue pipeline to the Pecos Power plant in Reeves County and the CPV Basin Ranch plant in Ward County. These are tie-in connections at existing pipe, with no new line, length or named project of their own. Neither Kinetik's Q1 2026 call nor CPV's Basin Ranch coverage names a data center customer; Basin Ranch is a 1,350 MW grid plant financed by the Texas Energy Fund. Searches run: 6.
